meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后，Mac 菜单栏会出现带圆点的螺栓图标。绿点表示 NanoClaw 运行中，红点表示已停止。点击图标可开始、停止或重启 NanoClaw。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器时触发。

say.text: 帮我在菜单栏加上 NanoClaw 的运行状态图标。
say.note: Claude 会检查环境并开始安装。

say.text: 检查一下 NanoClaw 菜单栏图标是否装好了。
say.note: Claude 会验证安装情况并告诉你结果。

say.text: 卸载 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: Claude 会按卸载步骤移除图标。

howto.what_en: After installation, a bolt icon with a dot appears in your Mac menu bar. Green means NanoClaw is running, red means stopped. Click it to start, stop, or restart NanoClaw.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. macOS only.

say_en.text: Add a NanoClaw status icon to my menu bar.
say_en.note: Claude checks the environment and starts installing.

say_en.text: Check whether the NanoClaw menu bar icon is installed.
say_en.note: Claude verifies the installation and reports.

say_en.text: Uninstall the NanoClaw menu bar status icon.
say_en.note: Claude follows the removal steps to uninstall.
